name: Tinker builds send their pet spellbook, so pet abilities resolve in macros (#5791)
contract: Tinker builds summon mechanical SUMMON_PET pets that learn their abilities (ZIGGI-6K 500481: Minicopter-Z 801626,
Revitalizing Aura 524839, Recharge 808010). Player::PetSpellInitialize writes the pet spellbook into
SMSG_PET_SPELLS only when Pet::IsPermanentPetFor is true, which held for Warlock demons, Death Knight ghouls and
the Mage's Water Elemental, so the Tinker's pet bar worked but the client got an empty pet spellbook and a
'/cast <pet ability>' macro found nothing. A Tinker's mechanical summon pet now counts as permanent. Expected: the
built ZIGGI-6K knows Minicopter-Z and the latest SMSG_PET_SPELLS (0x179) lists at least three pet spells (the
count byte after the 18-byte header and ten action slots). The client's macro lookup is not observable here.
